A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Open Dialogues can be a promising treatment approach for psychotic crises, but the dialogical approach needs to be further developed.
Open Dialogues with good outcomes are characterized by a dialogical sequence in which the client is able to express his/her own words and to be heard by the team.

Open Dialogue is based on a dialogical theory of mind, which means that we are not trying to change the patients' thoughts, but we are trying to understand them and to help them understand themselves.

the first treatment meeting is critical for the outcome of the psychotic crisis.
the first treatment meeting is a critical event in Open Dialogue.
